description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008 Notification under Section 3(2)
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. It grants specific tax exemptions and regulatory concessions to a designated strategic development project, making it a statutory notification that modifies the application of several existing laws (Inland Revenue Act, Value Added Tax Act, Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, Customs Ordinance, and Sri Lanka Export Development Act). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a regulatory matter.
